gen-fs-bevellier-gf-nata-sans: Nata Sans draws its round letters with wide, unclosed mouths and a steady, technical-pen hand. Nata Sans is the quieter half, which lets Bevellier's stencil-cut, tightly spaced heading do the talking.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-nobile: Nobile reads crisp and contemporary, with caps barely rising above the lowercase and mouths left open like unjoined arcs. Bevellier is best at wire-bent, flat-stroked display words, while Nobile does its best work as the low-key text beneath.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-nokora: Flat and glowing, like neon tube. Bevellier keeps one track width throughout, and Nokora backs it with a dark, thick stripe of lowercase and an s that never pinches shut.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic reads modern and open, its c leaving a welcoming gap and capitals sitting only just above the lowercase. Noto Kufi Arabic gives Bevellier's bent-pipe strokes and tight spacing a plain sans partner that never competes.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans: Noto Sans fills most of the letter height with its lowercase bodies and opens its c wide. Noto Sans would look oversized if made large, while Bevellier's hairline-free, swell-free letters would feel cramped if shrunk small.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Graceful is Bevellier's mood, with a w that has no thick or thin strokes, set over a body whose curve endings stay well apart. Size the Noto Sans Adlam text freely.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjo: Bevellier brings flat, unmodulated line weight and very close sidebearings to the top, a sophisticated, stencil-cut look. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined sits beneath, spacious and plain.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-: Graceful Bevellier holds its heading in flat strokes with no heavy-to-light shift, over a body whose terminals point outward and whose x-height nearly reaches cap height. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs would read smoothly.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Noto Sans Arabic reads clean and modern. Its wide openings on small letters and pronounced x-height carry a longer passage smoothly, while Bevellier above it keeps a signage-like plainness in every line weight.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-armenian: One stroke width runs through the whole Bevellier alphabet, giving it a stencil-cut, close-set poise, and Noto Sans Armenian gets on with the reading, its tall, full c, s and z opening round letters wide.
